title: SpaceX从火箭公司到AI巨头？LDV合伙人：平台型企业的进化逻辑
speaker: Winston Foo

segments.en: How do you look at this modern day da Vinci now? SpaceX before was all about rocket launches and providing satellite broadband for internet.
segments.zh: 你现在怎么看这个现代达芬奇？SpaceX以前主要是火箭发射和卫星宽带。

segments.en: Now it's almost becoming this aspiring AI juggernaut. How do you view this company now?
segments.zh: 现在它几乎要成为AI巨头。你现在怎么看这家公司？

segments.en: Again, because of the quiet period, I would just point you to the perspective of this, but in general, what technology companies can build platforms and then those who earn the right build applications on top of those platforms.
segments.zh: 由于静默期，我只能提供一般视角：科技公司可以构建平台，然后有资格的公司可以在平台上构建应用。

segments.en: And then those who earn the right build applications on top of those platforms.
segments.zh: 然后有资格的公司可以在平台上构建应用。
